changelog.name: v1.7
changelog.body:
Added fade with notifs panel switch (Thanks @Hyper.Alvi)
Added show on lockscreen switch (Thanks @Hyper.Alvi)
Added refresh gifs without SystemUI restart needed
Added a reminder
(Tell me if fade and show on lockscreen switches doesn't work on your device)
Soon a matrix rain module

Changed "Choose a gif" to "Add a gif"
Added possibility to use Giphy view in app to download gifs you want
Added "+" and "-" buttons next to seekbars to change value
Possibility to choose the view plane of the gif (in front of or in background of the notifications panel)
Animated gifs in the gridview
Increased gif size to 2000
Added a warning for mobile data
Fixed gridview duplicate selection bug when scrolling
Removed round seekbars value

Sorry for the apk size who has been drastically increased due to the Giphy library :(

Fixed storage permission on Android 10 (Sorry for the inconvenience)
Fixed storage permission warning text

Fixed selection color bug in gridview
Added top margin seekbar
Added ability to round seekbars values by long pressing texts above
Added possibility to add gifs as many as you want

Support Android 11
Added possibility to display up to 3 images at same time
Added scope for LSPosed
Added reset to default value when long press the "Size" text
Added an important warning at starting of the app
Added a splash screen
New app icon
Little modification to switch buttons
Signature has changed so I decided to rename the package name (Backup your settings)

readme:
## **This module allow you to add a gif or a picutre of your choice in notifications panel !**
/!\SINCE RIRU V22 YOU MUST ENABLE RESOURCE HOOK IN EDXPOSED SETTINGS/!\

/!\ SystemUI must be restart to apply modifications /!\
Officially working with :
OneUI (1.0 & 2.x)
AOSP (N to R)
OxygenOS
MIUI

/*PS : Don't hesitate to try it on your rom and tell me if it work or no, I can support a lot of roms with your help*/
